files.README.md:
# price-feed loader

Glenmoor Tools loads each supplier's nightly tool-price list into the
catalogue. The loader appends one line to logs/feed-loader.log for every SKU it
turns away and closes the run with a line carrying the run's totals; the SKUs it
accepts are counted in that closing line only, and the closing line accounts for
every rejected SKU of the run.

    <UTC time> WARN  sku=<id> rejected reason=<code>
    <UTC time> INFO  run finished date=<day> accepted=<n> rejected=<n>

The codes it writes are missing_currency (the list priced the SKU with no
currency), pack_size_missing (the list gave no pack size) and
price_out_of_range (the price fell outside the band agreed with the supplier).
No run lists a rejected SKU twice.
